proof:
Source: Step 6 and the first part of Step 7 of the parent proof (∫_W g = ∫_{W∖V} g + ∫_V g ≤ μ(W) − μ(V) + θ·μ(V)), stated for an arbitrary measurable V ⊆ W. All measures are read as real numbers via ENNReal.toReal. For an arbitrary set S, ∫_S g dμ is the integral with respect to the restricted measure μ⌞S, whose total mass is μ(S).

1. (Finiteness.) By monotonicity, μ(V) ≤ μ(W) < ∞ and μ(W ∖ V) ≤ μ(W) < ∞.

2. (Integrability.) For every set S, the hypothesis |g| ≤ 1 μ-a.e. implies ‖g‖ = |g| ≤ 1 μ⌞S-a.e. (ae_restrict_of_ae). Since g is μ-a.e. strongly measurable, g is integrable on every S with μ(S) < ∞ (Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded with bound 1). In particular, g is integrable on V and on W ∖ V. The constant 1 is also integrable on W ∖ V (integrableOn_const, since μ(W ∖ V) < ∞).

3. (Splitting.) The sets W ∖ V and V are disjoint (disjoint_sdiff_left), V is measurable, and (W ∖ V) ∪ V = W because V ⊆ W (sdiff_union_of_subset). setIntegral_union needs measurability only of the second set V, so it gives ∫_W g dμ = ∫_{W∖V} g dμ + ∫_V g dμ.

4. (Bound on the complement.) μ⌞(W ∖ V)-a.e. we have g ≤ |g| ≤ 1, and both g and 1 are integrable on W ∖ V. By monotonicity of the integral (integral_mono_ae), ∫_{W∖V} g dμ ≤ ∫_{W∖V} 1 dμ = μ(W ∖ V).toReal.

5. (Measure of the difference.) Since V ⊆ W, V is measurable and μ(V) < ∞, measure_sdiff gives μ(W ∖ V) = μ(W) − μ(V) in [0, ∞]. Since μ(V) ≤ μ(W) < ∞, ENNReal.toReal_sub_of_le gives (μ(W) − μ(V)).toReal = μ(W).toReal − μ(V).toReal.

6. (Conclusion.) Combine Steps 3–5 with the hypothesis ∫_V g dμ ≤ θ·μ(V).toReal. By linear arithmetic, ∫_W g dμ ≤ (μ(W).toReal − μ(V).toReal) + θ·μ(V).toReal = μ(W).toReal − (1 − θ)·μ(V).toReal. ∎
key_steps: μ V ≤ μ W < ∞ and μ (W \ V) ≤ μ W < ∞. Since |g| ≤ 1 a.e. and g is a.e. strongly measurable, g is integrable on V and on W \ V (Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded).
Split ∫_W g = ∫_{W∖V} g + ∫_V g using setIntegral_union (V measurable, W = (W ∖ V) ∪ V).
(μ (W ∖ V)).toReal = (μ W).toReal − (μ V).toReal by measure_sdiff and ENNReal.toReal_sub_of_le.
Linear arithmetic with ∫_V g ≤ θ * (μ V).toReal.
